profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
A versatile computing professional with expertise in developing software for high performance scientific computing applications, as well as the architecture and administration of high-performance, resilient networked systems. Throughout my career, I have designed, implemented, and supported software and systems that operate at very large scales. 

In my current role at the Rutgers Discovery Informatics Institute, a research laboratory at Rutgers University, I develop software infrastructure libraries for high-performance scientific computing workflows that run at machine-scale on leadership-class machines, such as Summit at ORNL, Theta at ANL, and Cori at NERSC. I work closely with domain scientists to improve the performance of their applications at scale in domains such as gyrokinetics, astrophysics, bioinformatics, and subsurface modeling.

As a Data Engineer at US Signal Company, one of the largest Network Service Providers in the Midwest, I was part of a team responsible for the growth and administration of packet-based services including DIA, Metro Ethernet, and MPLS VPN. As Senior Network Engineer, my role expanded to take the lead on complex projects and network architecture, while still including all the responsibilities of a Data Engineer.

Before coming to US Signal, I worked at I-2000 Inc, a regional ISP in Michigan, supporting a DSL, dialup, and fixed-wireless network as well as ancillary services such as DNS, Email, and web hosting.

Additionally, I have a special interest in statistical computing. I received a Master's degree in Computer Information Systems, applying statistical computational methods to problems in genetics using a high-performance computing (HPC) platform. This work allowed me to develop my interest in Machine Learning and HPC. As part of my Master’s thesis, I developed a parallel version of a common population genetics application using CUDA, achieving significant speed-up for a method (MCMC) that has been traditionally viewed as inherently serial.

Specialties: HPC Software Development, Data Management for HPC, Scientific/Statistical Computing, Network Engineering, Systems Administration, Network Architecture, Scripting, Unix/Linux Administration, Database Administration, MPLS

Languages include C, C++, Python, Bash, awk/sed, Perl, Fortran
Technologies include MPI, CUDA, RDMA, TCP/IP, IP Routing Protocols, MPLS, SLURM

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: This work is a continuation of my work at RDI2, with a new home at the SCI Institute at University of Utah. At SCI, I am continuing to develop software both in support of the Institute's research collaborations and in support of my own research into workflow descriptor languages and data engineering for scientific computing on HPC clusters.

company.name: Scientific Computing and Imaging Institute at the University of Utah

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
I was responsible for research software development at the RDI institute. This included managing the DataSpaces project, as well as participating in a number of multi-institutional collaborations, including the Exascale Computing Project and projects in the Department of Energy’s SciDAC program. 

Furthermore, my role involved supporting the research efforts of students, postdocs, and faculty at RDI through design, programming, and evaluation support. Our research software primarily consisted of software libraries that support scientific computing at very large scale, providing performance improvements to machine-scale runs on leadership-class DoE machines.

•	Collaborated on three Exascale Computing Project teams, achieving 100% on-time milestone delivery.
•	Developed new RDMA capabilities for the ADIOS2 streaming network transport, improving communication throughput for multi-petaflop applications.
•	Directed a development team consisting of multiple PhD students and postdocs.
•	Published computer science research papers at top-tier conferences, including Supercomputing, IPDPS, and Cluster Computing.

positions.title: Senior Network Engineer
positions.description:
As Senior Network Engineer, my role expanded to take the lead on complex projects and network architecture, while still including all the responsibilities of a Data Engineer.

•	Architected, engineered, and coordinated deployment of new network infrastructure.
•	Developed switched and routed network strategy.
•	Conducted lab testing to evaluate new equipment and designs.
•	Performed capacity planning and evaluation of network performance.
•	Supported sales by designing high-level customer solutions in response to customer needs.
•	Conducted written and oral group training explaining new equipment and designs.
•	Planned and executed a refresh of the core-routing platform.
•	Upgraded access layer technologies to provide better speed and feature options for customer circuits while reducing overall OSP fiber usage.
•	Designed and deployed a state-wide cellular backhaul network for a carrier customer.
•	Expanded the network by deploying new core-routing sites and markets.
•       Provided the highest level of technical escalation for customer and network issues.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
US Signal is one of the largest fiber-optic network operators in the Midwest. As a Data Engineer I was responsible for the growth and administration of packet-based services including DIA, Metro Ethernet, and MPLS VPN.

•	Coordinated with other groups to plan and execute network and high-level customer projects.
•	Provided support in case of high-level outages as part of a regular on-call rotation.
•	Designed and deployed tailored customer solutions and provided very high-level customer support.
•	Supported ancillary network services, such as AAA (RADIUS and TACACS+), logging, SNMP monitoring, email alerting, backups, etc.
•	Coordinated and performed service-affecting maintenance windows in conjunction with Field Operations and other engineering groups.
•	Administered Engineering project management system (Feng Office).
•	Provisioned DWDM and SONET transport circuits on Cisco ONS platform.

positions.title: Network and Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Internet 2000 is a regional ISP providing residential and business services. I was technical lead in the administration, engineering, and architecture of network infrastructure as well as managed services such as web hosting, email, and DNS. Additionally, I provided support for back-office systems such as RADIUS and the call center's IP PBX.

•	Engineered and administered a regional multi-protocol ISP network.
•	24x7 on-call for outage management and resolution. 
•	Engineered a successful data center migration on a live network infrastructure.
•	Migrated away from legacy transport services such as ATM and Frame Relay.
•	Deployed and maintained new and legacy support services, such as DNS, Email, and Web hosting.
•	Designed and implemented OSS and CRM web services in PHP, PERL, and ASP.NET.
•	Managed new and legacy server systems including Linux, FreeBSD, BSDi, Windows 2000, Windows 2003, and Windows 2008.
•	Migrated legacy servers to virtual machines using the VMWare hypervisor.
•	Provisioned and maintained transport circuits for several dozen wireless POP sites.
•	Administered office support systems such as IP PBX, Active Directory, and a 12,000-subscriber billing system.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: As a student, I spent two summers implementing an Emulab at Calvin College. This involved configuring several dozen end-nodes as well as networking equipment and service directors. The Emulab allowed network researchers to automatically deploy network topologies with prebuilt OS images on end nodes. This work was supported by an NSF grant.

volunteerExperiences.description: Kids' Food Basket is a Grand Rapids based organization that aims to fight childhood hunger by providing meals to disadvantaged children via their Sack Supper Program in West Michigan. Through this organization I have been able to assist in delivering meals to local schools.
